As Warehouse Manager, you will also be responsible for optimizing warehouse layouts, implementing inventory control procedures, and maintaining high standards of safety and quality. You will work closely with our sales and production teams, as well as our logistics partners, to forecast demand, plan inventory levels, and ensure smooth operations throughout our supply chain.

Do you have a proven track record in warehouse management and a commitment to operational excellence?
Are you confident in implementing process improvements and leveraging technology to enhance warehouse efficiency?
Do you want to help build a cohesive and high-performing team?

If so, you are the person we are looking for!

english:
THIS ROLE IS BASED IN ITALY AND REQUIRES NATIVE/FULL PROFICIENCY ITALIAN.

We are looking for an ambitious and dynamic Area Sales Manager to drive growth and strengthen our presence in Italy and across continental Europe. This position combines the management and development of existing customers with the search for and acquisition of new business opportunities across various sectors.

You will be responsible for building long-term relationships, ensuring customer satisfaction, and achieving sales targets by identifying new opportunities both in Italy and abroad.

This role also has a strong strategic dimension: you will define and execute strategies to expand the company — including new product development, distribution channel growth, identification of new market segments and receptive industries, and more — while working closely with senior management.

We expect and offer strong prospects for growth into a leadership position.

Sarai responsabile della costruzione di relazioni a lungo termine, della soddisfazione dei clienti e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita, individuando nuove opportunità sia in Italia che all’estero.
